freshness_invalidation.proves: kernel and project policy files are their own currency classes of the green-evidence key (unit), and a project-policy pin change invalidates the index and blocks task close (end to end)
a kernel change (update) re-runs the G5 full suite fresh instead of trusting prior green results; the runtime identity is a keyed class
kernel schemas are their own class; any change of a class's files changes the key and is attributed to that class (unit; the attribution is shown for four classes)
kernel migrations are their own class; a class change changes the key (unit)
plugin descriptors and the tool registry are their own class (unit); a changed plugin byte fails closed until re-approved (end to end)
a changed embedder pin or model artefact makes the index stale, blocks task close and forces a full re-embed
lifting a path-map exclusion makes index freshness stale; the repository contract is its own class
a changed authoritative input makes dependent work and its evidence stale until re-test evidence clears it
a source change changes the key (attributed to `source`); a file edited after indexing blocks close INDEX_STALE
an embedder or content change in the index manifest changes its digest while volatile fields do not; a stale index blocks close
DATA_SENSITIVITY is its own class; a class change changes the key (unit)
